item.title: WATCH: Escaped NYC owl Flaco honored in new documentary
item.description: ABC News' Danny New reports on a documentary about the Eurasian Eagle owl who became famous after escaping the Central Park Zoo.

item.title: U.S. launches new strikes on Iran after Trump warns of severe retaliation
item.description: The U.S. conducted strikes on Iran early Thursday, following President Trump's threat to hit the country hard.

item.title: Possible Russian missile lands in Poland amid attacks on Ukraine
item.description: Russian strikes across Ukraine killed at least eight people, and an apparent Russian missile crashed in Poland, officials said.

item.title: Government report to show U.S. economic performance amid Iran conflict
item.description: The U.S. economy is expected to have slowed slightly in the second quarter.
